name: Hong Hua
weapons: Black Magic (Bolganone, Wandering Wall, Glass Wheel, Thoron, Bolting)
personality: Weighed down by guilt over a past transgression, she fights for atonement and treasures memories of happier times.
story: A Mediator from Kunlun (around 925 years old) who once guided someone to Fortuna in the forbidden lands, an act tied to Eshmel's creation. She is a widow with a son.
joins: Automatically in the Prologue and again in Part III: Salvation. Joins at Lv40 as Ovate with Vulnerary and Bolganone. Base stats: HP 45, Str 15, Mag 34, Dex 30, Spd 26, Lck 18, Def 21, Res 30, Cha 23.

build.role: Utility mage: Rescue and Warp, Glass Wheel vs fliers
build.notes: Druid drops White Magic (Rescue, Warp). Valkyrium keeps both schools and adds Mov 7.

guide.role: Utility mage: Rescue and Warp move the strikers; Glass Wheel and Thoron from range
guide.summary: She moves the army: Rescue pulls a striker out after the kill, Warp (White S) drops Alexandra or Tobias onto the boss. Between moves she casts Glass Wheel on fliers or Thoron from 3 tiles; Zhu Ming adds Hit +10 to every spell.
guide.playstyle: Player phase: move last. Rescue whoever is exposed, or Warp a striker in, then cast if a target is left. Enemy phase: end out of bow and flier reach (Def 30 growth). Dismount on no-cavalry maps.
keys: Do Jurah's request (Dagda's Godshield) in Sec 2-3: it opens [[class:Valkyrium]].
Hit White A, Black A and Riding D by Lv 45: Arena Mage and Mounted weeks.
Push White S after the exam: Warp is her endgame job.
Rescue the striker who killed the boss's guard; never leave them in reach.
Glass Wheel on fliers: it targets Def and is effective vs fliers.
watch: Def: 30 growth, Ovate Def -10. Fliers and archers two-shot her: end behind the Fortress.
Mounted: spears are effective vs cavalry; dismount on spear-heavy maps.
Warp: White S. Rank at join ?; Rescue at B comes first.
Weight: Glass Wheel 7 or Bolganone 8 + Magic Staff 3 = 10 to 11. Thoron Wt ?. Doubled? Staff off first.
Amplify Magic: Lv 50 and 60 per Serenes Forest only (?).

decisions.pick: Ovate on join, Valkyrium from Sec 3 (Jurah's request)
decisions.why: Druid has no White Magic: Rescue and Warp, her job, would go. Valkyrium is the only Master class with both schools, adds Mov 7, Magic Heal +10 and Mount/Dismount. Ovate has bigger flats (Mag +4 vs +2) but Mov 5.
decisions.else: Stay Ovate if White A or Riding D stalls

decisions.why: Wiseman (White A) drops Black Magic: no Glass Wheel vs fliers, no Thoron, no Bolting. Orchel and Sofia already heal.

Join class: Mag +4, Dex +4 flat; Mov 5; fallback endpoint
Mag +30 growth, but no White Magic: loses Rescue and Warp
White only: loses Glass Wheel, Thoron, Bolting
